semantics.note: The categorical non-delivery forecast is firm. The separate three-to-four-year estimate retains its hedge and is not independently scorable.

contract.note: Reading the categorical parenthetical as predicting non-delivery is ordinary. Meaningful delivery under the identified agreement would fairly refute it; the hedged estimate supplies no deadline.

evidence.note: Identifies the March agreement and a company delivery promise, not actual commissioning or acceptance.
The company reports increasing the proposed offering from $3.75 billion to $4 billion. This corrects financing context without resolving delivery.
The company reports $4.3375 billion in closed principal. It establishes neither delivery nor the Meta signature's claimed sole causal role.
Company-reported construction progress and early-2027 guidance establish neither delivered capacity nor definitive termination.

reviews.rationale: The firm non-delivery forecast has no deadline. By the cutoff, the packet establishes neither meaningful delivery under the March agreement nor definitive termination without fulfillment. Financing disclosures and construction guidance do not trigger early resolution; the hedged construction estimate is not scored.

attribution.note: Zitron presents the deployment-rate estimate as his own conclusion.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the present-tense aggregate comparison and approximate six-month quantity. Approximation is not probabilistic hedging.

contract.note: Aggregate installation throughput is an ordinary reading. North American scope follows the surrounding calculation; using the latest completed quarter is reasonable and does not determine the unresolved result.

evidence.note: The filing explains that customer-headquarters revenue geography need not match shipment or installation geography. It does not measure deployment throughput.
CBRE measures annual leasing and occupancy, not operational NVIDIA GPU installations matched to quarterly sales.

reviews.rationale: Neither item supplies matched GPU sales and operational installation quantities. Geographic revenue attribution and property absorption expose weaknesses in the calculation, but do not establish a deployment time that supports or excludes approximately six months.
